problem: The sh:pattern constraint imposes an unrequired lexical restriction on the xsd:string value. The requirement and direct property/presence encoding require identification of the pyramid strength principle but do not require the exact case-insensitive phrase to occur in the value, so compliant descriptions can be rejected.
required_change: Remove sh:pattern "pyramid strength principle" and sh:flags "i"; retain the canonical property, xsd:string datatype, and presence constraint.
regression_guard: Preserve the required presence of nltl:pyramidStrengthPrinciple on nltl:ship without introducing an uncontrolled lexical-value restriction.
